item.title: Into Your Hands: Proverbs 27, Luke 23, Hebrews 11
item.description:
Luke 23:44-49, Hebrews 11:1-16, Proverbs 27:15-27
Proverbs 27:15-27, Luke 23:44-49 and Hebrews 11:1-16. The darkness and the torn curtain, Jesus' last prayer to his Father, and a chapter on faith for strangers looking for a city with foundations. item.title: Remember Me: Proverbs 27, Luke 23, Hebrews 10
item.description:
Luke 23:38-43, Hebrews 10:19-39, Proverbs 27:1-14
Proverbs 27 on tomorrow and the friend who wounds faithfully, the dying thief's prayer and Jesus' answer in Luke 23:38-43, and Hebrews 10:19-39 with its three calls to draw near, hold fast and stir one another up. With Calvin, Spurgeon, Chrysostom, Gill and Matthew Henry. item.title: Forgive Them: Proverbs 26, Luke 23, Hebrews 10
item.description:
Luke 23:32-37, Hebrews 10:1-18, Proverbs 26:17-28
Proverbs warns about meddlers, whisperers and smooth talkers, Luke 23 reaches the cross where Jesus prays 'Father, forgive them', and Hebrews 10 explains why one sacrifice finished what thousands could not. item.title: Green Wood and Dry: Proverbs 26, Luke 23, Hebrews 9
item.description:
Proverbs 26:1-16, Luke 23:26-31, Hebrews 9:11-28
The first episode of Morning Mercies joins the Navigators plan at month nine, day sixteen. We read Proverbs 26 on answering fools and the sluggard's imaginary lion, walk the road to the cross with Simon of Cyrene and the weeping women of Jerusalem in Luke 23, and follow Christ into heaven itself with his own blood in Hebrews 9. With Calvin, Chrysostom, Gregory the Great, Matthew Henry, Matthew Poole, John Gill, Spurgeon, R.C. Sproul and John Piper. Sources quoted: - Matthew Poole, Commentary on Proverbs 26:4 (via Bible Hub) (https://biblehub.com/commentaries/proverbs/26-4.htm) - Gregory the Great, Book of Pastoral Rule, Part III, chapter 30 (NPNF second series, vol. 12) (https://ccel.org/ccel/schaff/npnf212/npnf212.iii.iv.iv.xxxi.html) - John Gill, Exposition of the Bible, Proverbs 26:13 (https://www.biblestudytools.com/commentaries/gills-exposition-of-the-bible/proverbs-26-13.html) - Charles H. Spurgeon, Why Should I Weep? Sermon 1311 on Luke 23:27-31, October 22, 1876 (https://answersingenesis.org/education/spurgeon-sermons/1311-why-should-i-weep/) - R.C. Sproul, The Crucifixion (Part 1), sermon on Luke 23:26-36 (https://learn.ligonier.org/sermons/crucifixion-part-1-luke) - Matthew Henry, Commentary on the Whole Bible, Luke 23:26-31 (https://www.biblegateway.com/resources/matthew-henry/Luke.23.26-Luke.23.31) - John Chrysostom, Homily 15 on Hebrews (https://www.newadvent.org/fathers/240215.htm) - John Piper, The Only Conscience-Cleanser, Solid Joys devotional on Hebrews 9:14 (https://www.desiringgod.org/solid-joys/the-only-conscience-cleanser) - John Calvin, Commentary on Hebrews, 9:24-28 (https://ccel.org/c/calvin/comment3/comm_vol44/htm/xv.v.htm)
